# `auth.oidc.link`

Link an OIDC identity

Session with fresh auth. Starts a link-mode flow; posting the form redirects to the provider.

- Method and path: `POST /settings/security/oidc/link`
- Scope: `repo:read`
- Kind: `mutation`
- CLI: `rukie auth oidc link`
- MCP: `auth_oidc_link`
- Idempotency-Key: required on this mutation

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$schema` | body | no | `string` |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string` |
| `provider` | body | yes | `string` |

## Errors

`not-found`, `unauthorized`, plus the framework problems.
